year_filter.rule: The selected version must have a documented publication or version date inside the interval; earlier versions remain in the version chain.

lane_title: Gender, feminist and intersectional AI research, bias, fairness, diversity, critical AI literacy and professional education
scope: 2026 publications on generative AI, LLMs or directly relevant AI systems that substantively address gender, feminist or intersectional analysis, bias, inequality, diversity, fairness, critical AI literacy, professional education, social work, human services, mental health, health, counseling or consequential person-level decisions.

"LLM" racial ethnic gender bias psychiatric diagnosis 2026
"generative AI" diversity equity inclusion healthcare education 2026
"生成式人工智能" 偏见 心理健康 教育 2026
"ethics and fairness" AI deception detection mental health 2026
"generative AI" body image eating disorder equity 2026

searched_sources.role: bibliographic, version, access and peer-review evidence
medical identifiers, dates and open full text
preprint identity, dates and version status

searched_sources.source: Google/Bing web index through web search
searched_sources.role: candidate discovery only; final records grounded in primary sources

saturation.rationale: Repeated English, German, Spanish and Chinese concept/domain queries converged on the same direct social-work, health, education, hiring and representation clusters. Crossref, publisher, PubMed/PMC, OJS, institutional-repository and arXiv checks yielded diminishing new eligible Works. August 2026 indexing remains volatile, and some publisher pages did not expose item-level peer-review histories.
limitations: No subscription database search interface was available.
Some Elsevier and Wiley full texts were paywalled or blocked to automated retrieval.
Exact publication day was not exposed for DOI 10.1016/j.techsoc.2026.103402.
Peer-review status was left not_established whenever only a journal label, rather than item-specific evidence, was available.
